Declared HS 820559 is not what the visible export rows show — actual codes seen are 82041110 (hand tools/spanners), 84131110 (lever-action pumps) and 40082120 (tyre patches); per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground, the code should be corrected to the factual one (82041110 for the hand-tool line). Domestic supply status is unknown, not 'none found': the search backend was down and the secondary portals blocked access, so absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not proof of no domestic sales. Revenue and export volume figures are not public on the free views — left null, not estimated.
